CustomObject.label: Boundary Application
CustomObject.description: Represents an external system that is connected to Salesforce for sending or receiving data, such as middleware, an ERP system, a marketing automation platform, a CPQ tool, or a business intelligence platform. Each record answers the question "what outside system is touching Salesforce, and how critical is it?" Use this object, together with its related Object Mapping and Field Mapping records, to determine which external systems depend on a specific Salesforce object or field before making a metadata change such as adding a field, deleting or modifying a field, changing a field's type, or merging Account or Contact records.
